title: Dialogue Tree Definition
description: Schema for ALIS dialogue trees. Field names must match USTRUCT property names (case-insensitive) for FJsonObjectConverter auto-parsing. Every DLG_*.json file MUST include a $schema field pointing to this file (relative path). See FDialogueNode, FDialogueOption in DialogueTypes.h.

id.description: Unique dialogue tree ID (used for FPrimaryAssetId). RENAME WARNING: ProjectMind dialogue_thought_mappings.json references tree IDs in signal_tags. Run scripts/ue/check/gameplay/projectmind/validate_data.py after renaming.

startNode.description: ID of the first node to display

nodes.description: Map of node ID -> node definition. Keys are semantic IDs. RENAME WARNING: ProjectMind dialogue_thought_mappings.json references node IDs in signal_tags. Run scripts/ue/check/gameplay/projectmind/validate_data.py after renaming.

speaker.description: Speaker display name. Omit for objects/narration.

options.description: Player choices. If absent/empty, node uses 'next' for auto-advance or is terminal.

next.description: Target node ID. Omit or '$end' to end dialogue.

condition.description: Condition for option visibility. Empty = always visible. Use type 'inventory' to check item ownership or type 'tag' to check gameplay tags on the instigator actor.

type.description: Check instigator inventory for item ownership

id.description: Item ObjectDefinition id. RENAME WARNING: Must match object definition id field.

exact.description: true = exact id match, false = prefix/family match (default: true)

type.description: Check instigator actor for gameplay tag via IGameplayTagAssetInterface

exact.description: true = exact tag only, false = hierarchy-aware parent match (default: true)

next.description: Auto-advance to this node (used when no options). Omit for terminal.

actions.description: Action strings dispatched on node entry to IProjectActionReceiver components on ActionTarget (or owner), owner fallback, and instigator. Format: namespace.command[:argument]. Examples: lock.unlock, motion.open, inventory.consume:WaterBottle*, dialogue.set_tree:/ProjectObject/.../DLG_X.DLG_X. RENAME WARNING: inventory.consume references object definition IDs, dialogue.set_tree references DLG_*.json asset paths. Renaming either causes silent runtime failure.
